spark: a 2 GB persistent state store
Reject the GPU persistence claim: volatile VRAM is not a durable SQLite store; use disk transactions and budget model memory separately.
a high-level planning module generates a sequence of actions
Adapt the planner/executor separation; add explicit preconditions and verifier evidence because looping over task state does not itself detect deadlocks.
Only approved changes are applied
Retain the separation between proposals and authorized changes; bind approval to an immutable candidate and current policy version.
Each patch is validated against the SQLite task state
Adapt with actual file hashes and permission checks at execution; database state alone may be stale relative to the filesystem.
unified, immutable world representation stored in SQLite
Adapt as append-only observations plus a mutable projection; observed state is incomplete and cannot make arbitrary external actions reversible.
any deviations trigger immediate halting
Specify fail-closed behavior for concrete invariant violations; anomaly detection is not a proof of permission enforcement.
falsifiable, deterministic tests
Retain deterministic fault injection for recovery, but add exact crash boundaries and measurable invariants; no evaluation results were actually collected by this model.
On crash, the runtime automatically snapshots
Reject as a hard-crash guarantee: the process may execute no cleanup at all. Persist intent before the effect and reconcile after restart.
managing a queue of agents
Adapt into one bounded worker queue initially; no lock, lease or conflict protocol is specified for parallel execution.
highly feasible within the local-first constraints
Unsupported overall feasibility: the proposed VRAM/SQLite coupling is invalid and the 8 GB allocation ignores model and KV-cache requirements.
all cognitive actions are traceable and reversible
Reject universal reversibility. Traceability can be an engineering invariant for logged actions; reversibility depends on the tool and external system.
qwen: SQLite for persistent storage of task states and event logs
Retain as a modest starting point already supplied by the prompt; define transactions and distinguish journal durability from external file durability.
heuristic-based approach to select the next action
Useful simpler baseline; add a bounded action budget and deterministic validation. There is no specified heuristic or demonstrated reasoning capability.
rewards for correct actions and penalties for incorrect ones
Defer online RL until reward integrity, offline evaluation and permission invariance are specified; correctness cannot be taken from model self-report.
simple command-line interface for tool actions
A CLI does not ensure traceability or verification. Require typed actions, captured evidence and a trusted executor independent of model text.
the self as a set of capabilities
Adapt to an explicit capability registry with versioned permissions; avoid assuming the rule world represents all external state.
simple rule-based system
Adapt only with concrete scope checks and deny cases; no authority hierarchy or conflict resolution is defined.
comparing its performance to a baseline system
Underspecified: no task distribution, metrics, thresholds or actual experiment. The separate request for a falsifiable worked comparison is not fulfilled.
a simple crash recovery mechanism
Underspecified: no commit ordering, deduplication or file reconciliation. A database transaction alone does not cover a separate file edit.
agents can communicate and coordinate their actions
Defer: no communication schema, ownership or resource budget. A single executor is the lower-complexity baseline.
Use Python for its simplicity and extensive libraries
Python is compatible with the repository, but this is not a sizing or dependency analysis for a 12 GB workstation.
simple, rule-based system for world and self representation
No demonstrated novelty; keep simplicity as a baseline design preference, not an original cognitive architecture finding.
phi: a compact trie, for storing SQLite task states
Defer the trie: no key distribution, encoding or integration is defined; measure ordinary indexed SQLite before adding a second representation.
heuristics to generate action sequences
Adapt into a bounded planner returning typed candidates; rules and heuristics are implementable but no algorithm or quality evidence is given.
reward signals from task completion and error rates
Use these initially for offline reports, not automatic policy updates; distinguish verified success from a model claim.
modular action execution framework
Adapt to existing execution tickets and evidence records; modularity alone supplies neither authorization nor idempotency.
nodes representing entities and edges representing relationships
A possible later materialized graph over evidence; retain timestamps and provenance and justify its value over the existing state store.
checks patches against a set of predefined safety rules
Adapt with source/result hashes and current authorization checks. The output provides no rule implementation or completeness proof.
task completion, error rates, and resource utilization
Retain measurable outcomes; add fixed workloads and rejection thresholds. The proposed flat-file baseline comparison has no numerical pass criterion.
a journaling system that logs changes to enable crash recovery
The TaskState schema and worked example omit the file-write boundary and intent/result hashes; enrich them before claiming safe replay.
using message passing for communication
Defer distributed coordination until a bounded single-process queue is measured; delivery semantics and resource limits are missing.
focusing on modularity and reusability
Plausible incremental approach, but its later Implemented Components list is unsupported by this collection; proposals are not repository verification.
a lightweight, in-memory caching layer
Adapt only for reconstructible observations with versioned invalidation. This is a familiar optimization, not established novelty or a durability mechanism.
smollm: a fast, low-latency cache and a slower, more durable storage system
Retain the volatile/durable distinction, but sizes, eviction and authoritative data ownership are unspecified.
perception, reasoning, and action
Too generic for implementation: no state machine, failure bound or executor interface. Sensor processing also expands beyond the supplied file-runtime context.
self-supervised learning
Defer: no objective, training data, acceptance gate or permission constraint mechanism is defined.
action abstraction
No typed action schema or validation boundary is provided; natural-language understanding is not a substitute for executable permission checks.
understand its own internal state and make decisions
No representation or evidence source is specified; cannot derive a world/self data model from this assertion.
within the constraints of the user's permissions
Desirable outcome without an enforcement mechanism; require a trusted rule evaluator outside learned text generation.
a technique called "benchmarking"
Tautological description without metrics, baseline or falsification rule; it supplies no benchmark evidence.
machine learning algorithms and natural language processing to persist its state
Reject as a persistence mechanism: storage ordering and durable commits need explicit systems design, not unspecified NLP.
a technique called "orchestration"
No scheduling, messaging or conflict semantics; adds a label rather than an implementable coordination design.
a technique called "feasibility analysis"
No hardware sizing, runtime dependencies or measured constraints are provided, so feasibility is not established.
a technique called "insight generation"
No concrete insight is delivered. The length-capped output repeats its limitation and ends before its worked example.
granite: in-memory SQLite database for task state and event journaling
Reject this as the sole durable store; the output itself admits loss on crash and later promises persistent replay without specifying durable journal storage.
generating potential patches, validating them
Adapt the candidate/verifier loop with bounded retries; validity is not equivalent to task usefulness or a complete reasoning algorithm.
a reward-based system to adjust its decision-making process
Defer online updates until offline acceptance and independent outcome verification exist; no learning algorithm or permission invariance is specified.
authorized by a centralized authority before execution
Retain a single authority boundary for effects, with explicit capability checks and revocation semantics rather than negotiation over permission.
using a graph-based data structure
Optional projection over attributed observations; no schema, freshness rule or grounding test is given.
rule-based access control, a verifier for file patches
Adapt to existing gates and test their composition; crash recovery is operational safety and cannot replace authorization.
consistency of the final file state
Retain final-state consistency as an observable; replace vague more efficiently and accurately with exact hashes and fault-injection pass criteria.
In case of a crash, the event journal records the current state
Reject crash-time logging as a guarantee. Commit intent before effects and reconcile the filesystem before replaying pending patches.
decentralized, negotiation-based approach
Defer: conflicts with a simple centralized authority design unless delegation is clearly bounded; no negotiation protocol or resource cap is specified.
incremental development and testing of individual components
Retain incremental integration, but the claim that components are implemented is unverified and the volatile-persistence conflict must be resolved.
a "verifier-gated" approach for file patches
This was explicitly supplied by the prompt, so it is not independent novelty; reject treating unspecified risky actions as an exception to permissions.
falcon: on-disk SQLite for task state persistence
Retain disk persistence and separate transient GPU computation; the scalable pool still lacks a model/KV memory budget.
a hierarchical reasoning engine
Underspecified hierarchy and algorithms; implement a small bounded candidate loop before adding learning-driven planning.
continuously refine tool usage and action execution
Defer automatic RL: no reward trust, rollback, training budget or permission-expansion safeguard is supplied.
a modular tool library with customizable APIs
Adapt to a typed allowlisted interface; customizable APIs require stable contracts and independent authorization.
sensor data and AI-generated insights
Avoid treating generated insights as observations; provenance, freshness and confidence need explicit fields. External APIs are also unavailable in the prompt.
fail-safe mechanisms and ethical guidelines
Too vague to implement as governance; turn this into concrete deny rules and verifier evidence.
task completion rates, error detection rates, and user satisfaction surveys
Measurable categories but no workload, baseline, thresholds or actual results; add deterministic failure cases before subjective surveys.
a checkpointing mechanism to ensure data integrity
Checkpoint boundaries and file/SQLite atomicity are absent; the requested crash walkthrough was not produced.
each agent specializes in specific cognitive tasks
Potential later specialization; no bounded schedule, shared-state semantics or measured benefit over one worker.
Leverage cloud computing resources to scale the system dynamically
Reject for this study: paid hosted resources are explicitly unavailable and the target is one local workstation.
integrating quantum computing elements
Reject as unsupported scope expansion: no implementable mechanism or evidence of value within the declared hardware budget.
danube: demand-paged memory management system
A generic memory-management choice without a model/KV budget or clear CPU/GPU distinction; do not treat paging as durable task storage.
Integrate probabilistic reasoning to handle uncertain situations
Adapt only after defining uncertainty/evidence fields and a bounded planner interface; no inference algorithm or useful performance evidence is supplied.
based on labeled data
Defer training until task data, objective, budget and independent acceptance gates are specified; no permission-invariance mechanism is included.
Python's standard library and third-party APIs
Plausible implementation resources, but no typed interface, authorization or recovery contract. Third-party access must fit local availability constraints.
Use a state machine to represent the current state
Retain explicit states as a starting point, then define transitions and evidence; the proposed graph has no schema or freshness semantics.
do not violate user permissions
Retain as a requirement; turn the unspecified verifier and governance policies into concrete deny rules and versioned authority checks.
Collect user feedback to evaluate the system's usability
Useful supplementary metric, but the output supplies no objective thresholds or completed falsifiable comparison; its final experiment section is truncated.
restoring the file from a backup
Underspecified backup age, commit ordering and concurrent-edit handling. A backup restore can lose valid work or repeat an effect; reconcile hashes instead.
Use communication protocols to facilitate interaction
No actual protocol or ownership semantics; defer multiple writers until conflict and resource-budget behavior is defined.
Use version control systems to manage changes
Sound development practice rather than evidence of runtime feasibility; the 12 GB resource constraint remains unsized.
Decouple the reasoning and planning loop
Adapt to a stable candidate/executor interface; decoupling is a familiar engineering pattern and no originality has been established.
tinyllama: each process can access the same amount of memory
Reject as a GPU allocation guarantee; physical shared capacity does not imply equal safe allocations. Budget weights, KV cache and concurrent work explicitly.
first-in, first-out (FIFO) queue
Retain as a simple scheduler baseline; FIFO alone guarantees neither timely completion nor useful planning or safe parallel execution.
trained on a large dataset of planning and reasoning tasks
Unsupported training-data and implementation claim; treat RL as a proposal with no collected evidence, not a component verified in this repository.
RESTful API
Optional transport only; authentication, action schemas, permission checks and replay semantics are not defined.
a simple graph representation
No schema or grounding rules; consider only a derived visualization after structured evidence is in place.
hardware-based cryptography and hardware-based fault tolerance
Unsupported hardware assumptions and no tool-authorization boundary; not a usable governance specification.
a throughput of over 100,000 tasks per second
Reject invented empirical results: neither this throughput nor the claimed over-90-percent success rate was measured or cited. Preserve as evidence of hallucination.
a distributed file system (DFS)
Reject unnecessary distributed infrastructure for the single-workstation constraint; it still fails to define file-edit transaction recovery.
a distributed coordination mechanism
No protocol or delivery/ownership semantics; distributed complexity is unjustified without measured single-worker limitations.
designed to be modular and extensible
Unsubstantiated feasibility assertion; no dependencies, memory estimate or working implementation is supplied.
allowing for easy addition of new functionality
Generic extensibility statement repeats feasibility rather than providing a non-obvious design idea.
